Consistently Good and Reasonably Priced Family Restaurant
Sep 2023 • Family
In our recent trip to HCMC, we went back to this family restaurant again for our dinner, something that we will do whenever we revisit HCMC.

The foods were consistently good and despite there are some price increments, they were still worthwhile because the portions of the food were large and of course, authentic and yummy. In fact, the restaurant was mainly patronized by locals with only a few tourists.

As usual, we ordered the sliced pork noodles, lemongrass clams soup, pork ribs rice, stir-fried rice vermicelli with shrimps, deep fried shrimps and seafood fried rice.

The foods were yummy and service was prompt as always! It was a fulfilling and highly satisfactory meal!

Nice and authentic local food!
Dec 2022
This is one of the few restaurants that we will always return whenever we come by HCMC and in our recent trip, no exception.

Located opposite to Ben Thanh Market, this is a family restaurant patronized by many locals, besides the tourists. Prices were reasonable and food yummy and authentic.

In this visit, we found that the prices have gone up, possibly due to world inflation but the portion remained huge and quality consistently good. We always ordered the sliced pork noodles, lemongrass clams soup, chicken drumstick rice (I had wanted the pork ribs rice that I used to have but was no longer available in the menu) and the spring rolls were satisfactory though not the best we have eaten there. 

The food were overall yummy and service was fast as it was closed to 10pm when we arrived (after our visiting to the Opera theatre), and there were still a handful of tables of diners having their supper I supposed.

Recommend if you prefer authentic and nice local dishes at reasonable prices! Checkout my profile for more pictures and clips!

A must visit every time when in HCMC!
Sep 2019
This is a family styled restaurant located opposite Ben Thanh market that I will always "must visit" whenever I am in HCMC. In my recent trip there, I did drop by there twice for dinner and felt so familiar with the setting, food and staff (even the boss knew us)!

Located just about 5mins from our hotel (Blue Diamond, do refer to my earlier review here), the restaurant is always crowded with diners and so we always go there before dinner time and could eat at peace. However, despite of the crowd, service was prompt though.

We always ordered the pork ribs rice, sliced portk noodles, grilled prawns and white clams soup. They were very consistent in terms of quality and freshness and were very yummy. We especially love the home made sambal chilli, super spicy, hot but tasty!

Over the years, or rather, comparing to our previous visit here (in December 2018), the prices seemed to have increased by 5,000 to 15,000 dong per dish on average, but it's still cheap and reasonable, considering the food portion was huge and nice!

So, I do recommend this place and of course there are also many nice family run restaurants nearby and you can be spoiled for choices! :) For us, we are so familiar with this place and so its a "must visit"! :)
